title: Old Android APK removed; replacement build blocked
summary: Removed the old LECOMAX Learn APK from the phone's Zakaria folder. A replacement APK could not be produced because the offline Gradle build is missing the Foojay resolver plugin and network access is blocked.

validation.name: Old APK removal
validation.detail: ADB listing confirmed the old APK is no longer present in /sdcard/Zakaria.

validation.name: Replacement APK build
validation.detail: Gradle assembleRelease --offline failed because org.gradle.toolchains.foojay-resolver-convention:1.0.0 is not cached; the wrapper also could not download it due blocked network access.

validation.name: Replacement APK transfer
validation.detail: No new APK existed to copy.
